Hi all,

Here are the room details for the Lake Geneva offsite. Check-in opens Monday, Aug 17 at 9:00 AM, and check-out is Friday, Aug 21 by 11:00 AM. A welcome session starts at 10:00 AM on Monday in the main lodge.

Rooms are double occupancy by default and company-paid. A private room upgrade is available for $180 out of pocket for the week.

Please reply with:
1. Double or private room
2. Roommate preference, if any
3. Any room needs or arrival/departure timing I should know about

Thanks,
Coordinator
